global_rules.product_code: READ-ONLY for all audit lanes: no edits under src/, crates/, build.rs, installer/, .github/ — findings, never fixes
global_rules.findings_file: docs/audit/findings/<lane-id>.md (exclusive per lane; never a shared findings file)
